findings.summary: Decomposition Protocol Step 1 partitions DDs across tasks but does not declare a DELTA output mode for revision cycles; remediation cycles re-emit the full task_drafts set instead of a delta, risking silent loss of unrelated prior tasks.
findings.recommendation: Add a DELTA OUTPUT MODE section that activates when remediation_context is present, gating output on a pre-generation Read of each reviewer-artifact path.

findings.summary: Delta-mode output has no explicit TDD-preservation clause; the agent could emit a modified GREEN/UPDATE task without its prior RED depends_on link, breaking RED-before-GREEN invariants and testing-mode semantics.
findings.recommendation: Inside DELTA OUTPUT MODE, add an inline TDD-preservation rule stating that any modified task MUST preserve its existing depends_on RED-before-GREEN links and testing-mode classification verbatim unless a finding explicitly authorizes a change.

findings.summary: Backward-compat is implicit; without an explicit optional marker on remediation_context the agent cannot signal that the absent case preserves prior output shape.
findings.recommendation: Add remediation_context to Inputs with an explicit optional marker and preserve the existing `task_drafts` field heading in the Output Format.
